**Resolved / Related Issues**
Items resolved / related issues by this PR.
- Closes #5821
- Closes #4231 (back button, invoking a sidebar item, or otherwise navigating away will cancel the search)
- Closes #5813 
- Closes #5831
- Closes #3348
- Closes #3443
- related #2447

**Details of Changes**
Add details of changes here.
- make search more accurate by searching by filename instead of keywords (note: "$" is used to indicate advanced search and to not wrap in filename property)
- search items async
- show loading indicator while loading results
- allow refreshing search results
- allow cancelling search by navigating away
- allow dragging items in search results
- when no search results are found, show "no items found" instead of folder empty
other minor fixes:
- also fixes an issue where preview pane media controls would be too small
- fixes issue where trying to share a folder would cause the share flyout to crash
- improve thumbnails in details view by ThumbnailMode.SingleItem instead of ThumbnailMode.ListView
- fix issue where pressing open with overflow item with touch would unexpectedly close flyout

**Validation**
How did you test these changes?
- [x] Built and ran the app
- [ ] Tested the changes for accessibility

issue_context.title: Auto suggestions when searching are imprecise
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
When typing into the auto suggestion box, the suggestions might be totally unrelated to what I typed.

**To Reproduce**
Just search for something

**Expected behavior**
File names should contain the string I typed into the box

**Screenshots**
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/17484252/106918179-4383a680-6709-11eb-93d8-d3ec395c36e9.png)


**Desktop (please complete the following information):**
 - OS Version: 
Edition	Windows 10 Pro
Version	20H2
Installiert am	‎19.‎06.‎2020
Betriebssystembuild	19042.746
Leistung	Windows Feature Experience Pack 120.2212.551.0

 - App version: [v0.12.0]
comments:
@R3voA3 could you check if the files listed contain the search string? Or if they are inside a folder matching the search string?
What happens if you search for "name:YOUR SEARCH STRING"?
Name: string seems to work. So by default it searches the files' content? Sound like a weird behaviour. Most ppl will expect to only search for files containing the string in the name.
@R3voA3 by default It searches both (like windows explorer) but maybe we have the sorting wrong (matching file name should probably come before matching file contents)
@gave92 @R3voA3 I'll take a look at this one.

To fix this, we'd need to evaluate whether a setting which prepends "name:" to the beginning of the search query is desirable. Some users want to search file names by default rather than in item contents.
This issue should be resolved with #5842.
